items.notes: Ad-hoc validation run 2026-07-05 (not the GitHub Actions CI job — executed directly via `npm run perf:k6:smoke` against the live production URL from an isolated validation environment). k6 v0.54.0. Result: 19/19 checks passed, http_req_failed=0.00%, http_req_duration p(95)=76.91ms / p(90)=67.39ms — well within both this repo's CI thresholds (p95<1000ms, p99<2000ms) and the stricter internal APEX standard referenced by accepted-findings ticket APEX-1202 (p99<800ms). Raw evidence: artifacts/production-validation/performance-summary.json (committed alongside this entry). This is a point-in-time result against live network conditions, not a permanent guarantee — the next actual CI run on this workflow should still execute perf:k6:smoke itself and refresh this evidence.
